metadata.title: Start-SplashScreen
metadata.description: Start-SplashScreen is a PowerShell script designed to execute a series of scripts with a user-friendly graphical interface. It provides a visual representation of the script execution process, including progress updates and a status indicator. The script also offers the ability to open the running PowerShell terminal window for troubleshooting or additional actions.
